brief.meaningEn: Make an overlooked issue or fact visible for attention or examination.
brief.meaningZh: 揭示原本較少人注意的問題或事實，讓人得以檢視。
brief.grammar: Shine a light on + issue/gap; shone a light on is a natural past form. The subject is evidence or an action that reveals something.
brief.register: Neutral public-interest language; a researcher explains a survey result to residents.
brief.boundaryZh: 表示讓問題可見，不表示問題已解決；與既有 shed light on 意義接近，這裏保留來源的 shine a light on 構式。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是照明設備真的發光；僅有主張而無揭示內容，證據不足。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出哪項證據揭示哪個原被忽略的問題。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 268, row 7; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The survey will shine a light on transport gaps.

listening.en: The rent survey shone a light on hidden repair costs that tenants had been paying themselves.
listening.zh: 租金調查揭示了租客一直自行承擔、原本不顯眼的維修費用。
listening.promptZh: shone a light on 在這裏表示甚麼？

options.en: The survey made a hidden cost visible.
options.zh: 調查讓隱藏費用顯現。

options.en: The survey installed brighter bulbs.
options.zh: 調查安裝了更亮的燈泡。

options.en: The repair bills were already eliminated.
options.zh: 維修帳單已經取消。

options.en: The survey had no information about costs.
options.zh: 調查沒有任何費用資料。

listening.explanationZh: 調查揭露原本不明顯的開支。

reply.promptEn: A youth survey finds that rural pupils miss clubs because the last bus leaves before activities end. What has the survey done?
reply.promptZh: （青年調查發現，鄉郊學生因尾班巴士在活動結束前開走而不能參加課外活動。調查起了甚麼作用？）

options.en: It exposed a transport barrier to participation.
options.zh: 它揭示參與活動的交通障礙。

options.en: It made the timing problem visible.
options.zh: 它讓時間安排問題顯現。

options.en: It shone a light on an overlooked access gap.
options.zh: 它揭示原被忽略的參與缺口。

options.en: It gave planners evidence about why pupils miss clubs.
options.zh: 它為規劃者提供學生缺席原因的證據。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均指向調查揭示交通時間缺口。

scene.promptZh: 統計顯示夜班工人很少能使用日間診所，議員首次注意到這項缺口。哪句貼切？

options.en: The figures shine a light on a gap in clinic access.
options.zh: 數字揭示診所使用機會的缺口。

options.en: The figures have already built a night clinic.
options.zh: 數字已建成夜間診所。

options.en: The figures are a physical spotlight in the building.
options.zh: 數字是建築物內的實體射燈。

scene.explanationZh: 數字讓原被忽略的問題可見。

options.en: The audit shone a light on missing ramps; repairs are still being planned.
options.zh: 審計揭示缺少斜道；維修仍在規劃。

options.en: The audit shone a light on missing ramps, so every ramp was already built.
options.zh: 審計揭示缺少斜道，因此每條斜道都已建成。

options.en: The audit made a literal light brighter, which automatically solved access.
options.zh: 審計把實體燈照亮，便自動解決通道問題。

contrast.explanationZh: 知道缺口不等於已修好。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說 shine a light on 只能指真正開燈。哪句較準確？

options.en: A careful report can shine a light on a neglected problem.
options.zh: 細緻報告可揭示被忽略的問題。

options.en: Yes, it only refers to lamps.
options.zh: 對，它只指燈具。

options.en: It means deliberately hiding a problem.
options.zh: 它表示刻意隱瞞問題。

dialogue.explanationZh: 比喻把資訊帶到人們視野中。

speaking.en: The attendance report shines a light on which evening classes working parents cannot reach; the centre still needs to respond.
speaking.zh: 出席報告揭示上班家長難以前往哪些晚間課程；中心仍須作出回應。
speaking.promptZh: 指出報告揭示甚麼，以及尚未完成甚麼。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區泳池公布無障礙更衣室使用調查，發現某時段門禁常失靈；管理層因此首次看見問題，但維修尚未完成。用英文區分揭示與解決。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩個示範都應寫出調查揭示某時段門禁失靈、管理層現在知道問題、維修尚未完成。

examples.en: The pool survey shines a light on the changing-room door failing at certain times. Managers can now see the issue, but repairs are not complete.
examples.zh: 泳池調查揭示更衣室門在某些時段失靈；管理層如今知道問題，但維修尚未完成。

examples.en: By showing repeated access-door failures at particular times, the survey shone a light on a problem managers had missed; fixing it is still pending.
examples.zh: 調查顯示特定時段門禁反覆失靈，揭示管理層之前忽略的問題；維修仍待完成。

takeaways.en: Shine a light on reveals an issue for examination.
takeaways.zh: shine a light on 指揭示問題供人檢視。

takeaways.en: A report can shine a light on a gap before anyone fixes it.
takeaways.zh: 報告可先揭示缺口，修補則仍需另外進行。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending. Guide-written source provenance; newly written practice. No human or release approval is implied.

brief.meaningEn: Revitalise a place or activity by adding new energy, use or participation.
brief.meaningZh: 為地方或活動注入新活力，帶來新用途或參與。
brief.grammar: Breathe fresh life into + place/activity; subject is a change that renews it. Source uses a healthy visitor economy renewing a city.
brief.register: Neutral to positive civic commentary; a community organiser describes a revived venue to residents.
brief.boundaryZh: 須有可見的新活動或參與，不只是換一個標誌；也不保證所有舊問題消失。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是向城市真的吹氣；fresh life 指活力而非新生命。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出具體何種新使用者或活動令地方重現活力。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 268, row 10; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: A healthy visitor economy breathes fresh life into the city.
sources.expression: breathes fresh life into the city

listening.en: Weekend workshops brought young makers into the quiet repair hall and breathed fresh life into the space.
listening.zh: 週末工作坊吸引年輕創作者來到原本冷清的維修禮堂，為場地注入新活力。
listening.promptZh: breathed fresh life into 在這裏表示甚麼？

options.en: The workshops gave the hall renewed activity.
options.zh: 工作坊令禮堂重新活躍。

options.en: People literally blew air into the building.
options.zh: 人們真的向建築物吹氣。

options.en: The hall has no more maintenance needs.
options.zh: 禮堂再沒有維修需要。

options.en: The workshops closed the hall permanently.
options.zh: 工作坊令禮堂永久關閉。

listening.explanationZh: 新參與者和活動令冷清場地活躍。

reply.promptEn: An old pier was rarely used. A weekly craft market now draws local artists and families there, and cafés have extended their hours. What changed?
reply.promptZh: （舊碼頭過去很少人使用；每週工藝市集現在吸引本地藝術家與家庭，咖啡店也延長營業。發生了甚麼變化？）

options.en: The pier has renewed activity.
options.zh: 碼頭重新有活動。

options.en: More people now use the area.
options.zh: 現在更多人使用該區。

options.en: The market breathed fresh life into the pier.
options.zh: 市集為碼頭注入新活力。

options.en: The surrounding cafés have become busier.
options.zh: 附近咖啡店也更熱鬧。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均由市集及營業時間變化判斷活力增加。

scene.promptZh: 空置學校禮堂每月舉辦居民合唱及免費展覽，使用人數上升。哪句貼切？

options.en: The new programme breathes fresh life into the hall.
options.zh: 新活動為禮堂注入新活力。

options.en: The hall literally breathes like a person.
options.zh: 禮堂真的像人一樣呼吸。

options.en: A new logo alone proves participation has risen.
options.zh: 單憑新標誌便證明參與增加。

scene.explanationZh: 具體活動和人數支持活力。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句有足夠的 revitalisation 證據？

options.en: The reopened courtyard now hosts concerts and local stalls, breathing fresh life into the area.
options.zh: 重開的庭院現在舉辦音樂會和本地攤檔，為該區注入新活力。

options.en: The courtyard changed its sign but stayed shut and empty, so it breathed fresh life into the area.
options.zh: 庭院只換標誌，仍關閉空置，卻說注入活力。

options.en: One visitor walked past without entering, so all district problems vanished.
options.zh: 一人路過但沒進入，於是該區所有問題消失。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說 fresh life into 表示「舊問題全部解決」。哪句較準確？

options.en: New classes can breathe fresh life into a centre while repair work remains.
options.zh: 新課程可為中心注入活力，即使維修仍未完成。

options.en: Yes, revitalisation makes every repair unnecessary.
options.zh: 對，重獲活力令所有維修都不再需要。

options.en: It means the centre must be demolished.
options.zh: 它表示中心必須拆卸。

dialogue.explanationZh: 活力增加不等於所有問題解決。

speaking.en: The evening performances breathed fresh life into the old square, bringing residents back after years of quiet.
speaking.zh: 晚間演出為舊廣場注入新活力，讓多年少人使用的廣場再次吸引居民。
speaking.promptZh: 指出令廣場活躍的新活動。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：舊火車站候車室多年冷清；改作社區閱讀角和週末手作課後，居民經常到訪，但屋頂仍需修理。用英文說明活力增加及未解決的限制。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩個示範都應寫出原本冷清、閱讀角及週末手作課吸引居民、屋頂仍需維修。

examples.en: A reading corner and weekend craft classes have breathed fresh life into the quiet old waiting room, drawing residents back, although its roof still needs repair.
examples.zh: 閱讀角和週末手作課為原本冷清的舊候車室注入新活力，吸引居民重返，雖然屋頂仍須維修。

examples.en: The former station waiting room now welcomes residents for reading and weekend crafts. Those activities breathe fresh life into it, but they do not fix the damaged roof.
examples.zh: 舊車站候車室如今讓居民閱讀和參加週末手作活動；這些活動為它注入新活力，但沒有修好受損屋頂。

takeaways.en: Breathe fresh life into marks a place or activity becoming lively again.
takeaways.zh: breathe fresh life into 指地方或活動重現活力。

takeaways.en: Breathing fresh life into a venue does not repair every defect.
takeaways.zh: 為場地注入活力，不等於修好所有缺陷。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending. Guide-written source provenance; newly written practice. No human or release approval is implied.

brief.meaningEn: Arrive in large numbers, often flowing toward a concentrated destination.
brief.meaningZh: 大量人群湧向某處，常集中於特定地點。
brief.grammar: Crowds/visitors pour into + place; subject is plural people or a collective crowd. Past poured, progressive pouring.
brief.register: Neutral news or visitor-management language; a station coordinator describes crowd flow to staff.
brief.boundaryZh: 重點是大量、集中地到達，不必指擁擠到危險；少數幾人進門不宜如此形容。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是液體真的倒入；若人群分散往多處，也不能說湧入同一地點。
brief.outcomeZh: 能根據人數和聚集位置判斷是否貼切。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 269, row 2; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Holiday crowds pour into the same places.

listening.en: Hundreds of spectators poured into the small stadium after the gates opened.
listening.zh: 閘門開放後，數百名觀眾湧入小型運動場。
listening.promptZh: poured into 在這裏表示甚麼？

options.en: A large crowd entered the same place.
options.zh: 大量人群進入同一地方。

options.en: Water was poured onto the seats.
options.zh: 水被倒在座位上。

options.en: Only two spectators entered.
options.zh: 只有兩名觀眾進入。

options.en: The spectators left before the gates opened.
options.zh: 觀眾在開閘前已離開。

listening.explanationZh: 數百人同時進入小型場地。

reply.promptEn: The opening bell rings at a new night market. Within ten minutes, several hundred people enter through the same eastern gate. How would a marshal describe the flow?
reply.promptZh: （新夜市開市鐘聲響起；十分鐘內數百人從同一個東門進入。糾察員會怎樣描述人流？）

options.en: A large group is entering the eastern gate.
options.zh: 大批人正從東門進入。

options.en: The crowd is concentrated at one entrance.
options.zh: 人潮集中在一個入口。

options.en: Visitors are pouring into the market through the east gate.
options.zh: 訪客正從東門大量湧入夜市。

options.en: The entrance is handling many arrivals quickly.
options.zh: 入口正在短時間內處理大量到訪者。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均根據數百人集中東門的資訊。

scene.promptZh: 大型講座開始前，幾百名聽眾同時走進同一禮堂。哪句貼切？

options.en: Attendees poured into the hall before the talk.
options.zh: 講座前聽眾大量湧入禮堂。

options.en: One person quietly entered a nearly empty hall, so crowds poured in.
options.zh: 一個人走進空禮堂，所以人潮湧入。

options.en: The hall poured water onto the attendees.
options.zh: 禮堂把水倒在聽眾身上。

scene.explanationZh: 大量人同往一處符合比喻。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句有足夠人數與集中地點？

options.en: After the race, hundreds of runners poured into the single rest tent.
options.zh: 賽跑後數百名跑手湧入同一休息帳篷。

options.en: Two runners went to separate cafés, so they poured into the same tent.
options.zh: 兩名跑手往不同咖啡店，卻說湧入同一帳篷。

options.en: A cup of water was poured into a bottle, so visitors poured into the venue.
options.zh: 一杯水被倒進瓶，因此訪客湧入場地。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說 pour into 一定表示有安全事故。哪句較準確？

options.en: Visitors may pour into a gallery in large numbers without an incident.
options.zh: 訪客可大量湧入畫廊，而不一定發生事故。

options.en: Yes, it always means someone is hurt.
options.zh: 對，它必定表示有人受傷。

options.en: It only describes liquid, never people.
options.zh: 它只描述液體，不能描述人群。

dialogue.explanationZh: 大量流入不自帶事故結論。

speaking.en: When the free concert ended, families poured into the nearby food hall, and staff opened another serving line.
speaking.zh: 免費音樂會結束後，家庭大量湧入附近食堂，職員增設一條供餐隊伍。
speaking.promptZh: 指出職員因人流而作出的安排。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：科學節首日，三百名訪客在開門後二十分鐘內集中進入同一實驗展廳；職員增設另一入口，但沒有人受傷。用英文描述人流並避免推斷事故。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩個示範都應寫出三百人、二十分鐘內、同一展廳、增設入口及無傷者；不能說湧入必然造成事故。

examples.en: Three hundred visitors poured into the same science hall within twenty minutes of opening, so staff opened another entrance; nobody was hurt.
examples.zh: 開門後二十分鐘內三百名訪客湧入同一科學展廳，職員因此增設入口；無人受傷。

examples.en: Within twenty minutes, a crowd of three hundred poured into one experiment hall. Staff added an entrance to spread arrivals, and there were no injuries.
examples.zh: 二十分鐘內三百人湧入同一實驗展廳；職員增設入口以分散人流，沒有傷者。

takeaways.en: Pour into describes a large group arriving at a place.
takeaways.zh: pour into 描述大量人群進入某地。

takeaways.en: People can pour into a venue without causing an accident.
takeaways.zh: 人群可以大量湧入場地，而不一定造成事故。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending. Guide-written source provenance; newly written practice. No human or release approval is implied.

brief.meaningEn: Make progress against a strong opposing flow, crowd, tendency or pressure.
brief.meaningZh: 逆著強大的水流、人潮、趨勢或壓力艱難前行。
brief.grammar: Swim upstream; in literal context fish swim against a current, figuratively a person struggles against opposing forces. Source compares walking against crowds.
brief.register: Conversational vivid description; an event marshal explains the difficulty of moving against an exiting crowd.
brief.boundaryZh: 必須有可辨的相反力量；一般困難但沒有對抗方向時未必貼切。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不一定真的在水裏游泳；也不等於逆勢者必定失敗。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出前進方向與阻力來源。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 269, row 4; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Walking through the crowds felt like swimming upstream.

listening.en: As the parade crowd left the square, the medic tried to reach the stage against the flow; it felt like swimming upstream.
listening.zh: 遊行人潮離開廣場時，醫護員逆著人流走向舞台，感覺像逆流而上。
listening.promptZh: swimming upstream 在這裏表示甚麼？

options.en: The medic was moving against a strong crowd flow.
options.zh: 醫護員正逆著強大人流前進。

options.en: The medic was swimming in a river.
options.zh: 醫護員真的在河裏游泳。

options.en: Everyone moved in the medic’s direction.
options.zh: 所有人都與醫護員同方向移動。

options.en: The stage had already disappeared.
options.zh: 舞台已經消失。

listening.explanationZh: 醫護員與離場人潮方向相反。

reply.promptEn: At the end of a festival, most visitors head toward the station. A cleaner must push a trolley toward the far end of the site through the opposite flow. How does the journey feel?
reply.promptZh: （節慶結束時，大多數訪客走向車站；清潔員須推車逆著人流走到場地另一端。這段路感覺如何？）

options.en: The cleaner is moving against the crowd.
options.zh: 清潔員正逆著人潮移動。

options.en: The flow of visitors makes the task harder.
options.zh: 訪客人流令任務更難。

options.en: It feels like swimming upstream.
options.zh: 感覺像逆流而上。

options.en: The cleaner’s direction opposes the main movement.
options.zh: 清潔員方向與主要人流相反。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均根據推車方向與離場人流相反作答。

scene.promptZh: 大多數店舖取消維修服務，一家店卻嘗試保留，因供應商改變政策而十分費力。哪句可作比喻？

options.en: The shop is swimming upstream against the industry trend.
options.zh: 店舖逆著行業趨勢艱難前行。

options.en: The shop is literally swimming in a street.
options.zh: 店舖真的在街上游泳。

options.en: Every supplier supports the shop’s plan fully.
options.zh: 每個供應商都完全支持店舖計劃。

scene.explanationZh: 店舖逆著普遍趨勢與供應商政策。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句有明確的相反力量？

options.en: She is swimming upstream by keeping repair workshops open as funding shifts toward replacement sales.
options.zh: 資助轉向新貨銷售，她仍維持維修工作坊，是逆勢而行。

options.en: She runs a workshop with full funding and support, so she is swimming upstream.
options.zh: 她有充足資助與支持，仍說逆流而上。

options.en: She enjoys an easy walk in the same direction as everyone else, so she is swimming upstream.
options.zh: 她與所有人同方向輕鬆走，也說逆流而上。

contrast.explanationZh: 資助方向相反，是實在阻力。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說 swimming upstream 必定表示最後會失敗。哪句較準確？

options.en: A group can be swimming upstream against policy and still achieve change.
options.zh: 團體可逆著政策艱難前行，仍可能促成改變。

options.en: Yes, swimming upstream always ends in failure.
options.zh: 對，逆流而上一定失敗。

options.en: It means there is no opposing force.
options.zh: 它表示毫無相反阻力。

dialogue.explanationZh: 艱難不等於結果已注定。

speaking.en: Keeping a repair café open while nearby shops switch to disposable goods feels like swimming upstream, but volunteers continue.
speaking.zh: 附近店舖都轉售即棄品時，維持維修咖啡館營運感覺像逆流而上，但義工仍繼續。
speaking.promptZh: 指出義工面對的行業趨勢。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：校園想減少即棄餐盒，但附近供應商大多只提供即棄包裝；學生會仍與一家可重用盒供應商試行合作。用英文說明相反趨勢和繼續嘗試。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩個示範都應寫出校園減少即棄餐盒、供應商多只供即棄包裝、學生會仍試行可重用盒合作。

examples.en: The student union is swimming upstream against suppliers that mainly offer disposable boxes, but it is piloting reusable containers to cut campus waste.
examples.zh: 供應商主要提供即棄餐盒，學生會仍逆勢而行，試行可重用容器以減少校園廢物。

examples.en: Most nearby suppliers sell only disposable meal boxes. The union still wants fewer on campus and is swimming upstream by testing a reusable-box partnership.
examples.zh: 附近供應商大多只售即棄餐盒；學生會仍想減少校園使用量，並透過試行可重用盒合作逆勢而行。

takeaways.en: Swimming upstream means moving against a strong opposing force.
takeaways.zh: swimming upstream 指逆著強大阻力前行。

takeaways.en: A project can be swimming upstream and still keep making progress.
takeaways.zh: 項目即使逆勢而行，仍可繼續進展。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending. Guide-written source provenance; newly written practice. No human or release approval is implied.

brief.meaningEn: Damage a much-loved place through too many visitors or excessive use.
brief.meaningZh: 因太多人喜愛及過度使用某地，反而令它受損。
brief.grammar: Love + place + to death; object names a place and to death is hyperbolic, not literal fatal harm. Source concerns excessive visitation.
brief.register: Vivid environmental commentary; a park ranger explains visitor pressure to tourists.
brief.boundaryZh: 須同時有受歡迎與過度使用造成的損害，並非「愛」本身有害，也不是真的死亡。
brief.misconceptionZh: 僅有很多人到訪而沒有損害證據，不足以判斷；不要把比喻寫成致命事件。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出受歡迎、過度使用及具體損害之間的關係。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 269, row 10; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Too many visitors can love a place to death.

listening.en: Thousands visit the tiny cliff path each weekend, wearing away the soil they came to admire. They may be loving the path to death.
listening.zh: 每週末數千人走上狹窄山崖步道，磨蝕他們本來欣賞的土地；他們可能把步道愛得受損。
listening.promptZh: loving the path to death 表示甚麼？

options.en: Heavy use is damaging a popular place.
options.zh: 過度使用正在破壞受歡迎的地方。

options.en: Visitors dislike the path and avoid it.
options.zh: 訪客討厭步道而避開。

options.en: The path is a living person who has died.
options.zh: 步道是一個已死的人。

options.en: The soil is recovering because nobody walks there.
options.zh: 土地因沒人走過而復原。

listening.explanationZh: 大量人為欣賞而到訪，卻造成土壤磨蝕。

reply.promptEn: A quiet waterfall became famous online. Large visitor numbers now crush the plants beside it, though people come because they admire its beauty. What is the irony?
reply.promptZh: （寧靜瀑布在網上走紅；大量訪客如今踩壞旁邊植物，雖然大家都是因欣賞美景而來。諷刺在哪裏？）

options.en: Admiration is bringing damaging pressure.
options.zh: 欣賞反而帶來破壞壓力。

options.en: The attraction’s popularity harms nearby plants.
options.zh: 景點走紅損害附近植物。

options.en: Visitors risk loving the waterfall site to death.
options.zh: 訪客可能把瀑布景點愛得受損。

options.en: The reason people visit is helping cause the damage.
options.zh: 人們到訪的動機反而促成損害。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均指出受歡迎與踩壞植物的反差。

scene.promptZh: 小島觀鳥徑走紅後，大量人離開步道踩壞繁殖地。哪句貼切？

options.en: Visitors are loving the bird path to death by trampling the nesting ground.
options.zh: 訪客踩壞繁殖地，可能把觀鳥徑愛得受損。

options.en: Visitors are simply admiring birds without affecting the site.
options.zh: 訪客只欣賞鳥類，沒有影響環境。

options.en: The path has literally died like an animal.
options.zh: 步道真的像動物一樣死亡。

scene.explanationZh: 大量到訪帶來具體生境損害。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句具有完整的比喻條件？

options.en: People love the cave, but their repeated touching damages its paintings; they could love the cave to death.
options.zh: 人們喜愛山洞，但反覆觸摸損害壁畫，可能把山洞愛得受損。

options.en: One careful visitor admires the cave without touching it, so she loves it to death.
options.zh: 一名小心訪客不觸摸地欣賞山洞，因此把它愛得受損。

options.en: The cave is unpopular and untouched, so crowds love it to death.
options.zh: 山洞不受歡迎也無人觸碰，卻說人潮使它受損。

contrast.explanationZh: 喜愛、反覆使用、具體損害均存在。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說 love a place to death 指真的殺死一個人。哪句修正較準確？

options.en: Tourists can love a fragile site to death when heavy visits damage it.
options.zh: 遊客過度到訪損害脆弱景點時，可說把地方愛得受損。

options.en: Yes, a person must literally die.
options.zh: 對，必須真的有人死亡。

options.en: It means the site is never visited.
options.zh: 它表示景點從無人到訪。

dialogue.explanationZh: 死亡是誇張比喻，指環境受損。

speaking.en: The small garden is loved, but repeated shortcutting has worn its flower beds away; visitors may love the garden to death.
speaking.zh: 小花園很受喜愛，但訪客反覆抄捷徑踩壞花圃，可能把花園愛得受損。
speaking.promptZh: 指出受歡迎與受損如何同時發生。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：海邊潮池因美麗而吸引大量遊客；遊客反覆踏入淺池拍照，破壞脆弱生物。管理員想設限定路線保護它。用英文說明諷刺及措施。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩個示範都應提及潮池受喜愛、大量拍照者踏入造成生物受損、管理員設限定路線。

examples.en: Visitors may love the tide pools to death: repeated photo stops in the shallow water harm fragile creatures, so rangers will mark a limited route.
examples.zh: 遊客可能把潮池愛得受損：他們為拍照反覆踏入淺水，傷害脆弱生物，因此管理員會劃設限定路線。

examples.en: The beauty of the tide pools draws crowds, but walking into them for photos damages small creatures. To avoid loving the site to death, rangers plan a marked route.
examples.zh: 潮池美景吸引人潮，但遊客走入池中拍照會傷害小生物。為免把景點愛得受損，管理員計劃劃設路線。

takeaways.en: Love a place to death describes popularity that damages it.
takeaways.zh: love a place to death 描述受歡迎卻因過度使用而受損。

takeaways.en: To love a site to death, visits must cause real harm, not just be numerous.
takeaways.zh: 說景點被愛得受損，須有實際傷害，不能只看人數。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending. Guide-written source provenance; newly written practice. No human or release approval is implied.

brief.meaningEn: A very large number of options, sometimes difficult to sort through.
brief.meaningZh: 選擇極多，有時難以逐一比較。
brief.grammar: A sea of choices; sea is singular, choices plural. Can be a sea of similar choices if the options are numerous.
brief.register: Conversational consumer description; a librarian helps a patron narrow a long catalogue.
brief.boundaryZh: 重點是數量龐大，不必斷言每個選項都不好或一定令人困惑。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是海洋；只有兩個選項時不宜說 a sea of choices。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用具體數量或種類支持選擇極多的描述。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 270, row 3; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Online shoppers can feel lost in a sea of choices.

listening.en: The festival app lists hundreds of talks, films and workshops; visitors face a sea of choices.
listening.zh: 節慶程式列出數百場講座、電影及工作坊，訪客面對琳瑯滿目的選擇。
listening.promptZh: a sea of choices 在這裏表示甚麼？

options.en: There are very many options.
options.zh: 選項非常多。

options.en: The events take place under the sea.
options.zh: 活動在海底舉行。

options.en: Only two talks are available.
options.zh: 只有兩場講座可選。

options.en: Every option is necessarily poor.
options.zh: 每個選項必定不好。

listening.explanationZh: 數百項跨類別活動支持數量龐大。

reply.promptEn: A parent opens a course catalogue with more than four hundred classes across sports, art and science. She wants filters by age and location. Why?
reply.promptZh: （家長打開課程目錄，裏面有四百多個體育、美術與科學課程；她想按年齡和地點篩選。原因是甚麼？）

options.en: The catalogue offers a very large range.
options.zh: 目錄提供極多課程。

options.en: Filters would help narrow the options.
options.zh: 篩選功能可縮小選擇範圍。

options.en: She is facing a sea of choices.
options.zh: 她面對琳瑯滿目的選擇。

options.en: Sorting hundreds of classes takes effort.
options.zh: 比較數百課程需要工夫。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均根據四百多課程及篩選需要作答。

scene.promptZh: 網站列出七百種歷史照片授權方案，使用者須先按用途篩選。哪句貼切？

options.en: Users face a sea of choices before filtering the licences.
options.zh: 篩選授權前，使用者面對大量選擇。

options.en: Seven hundred licences are literally an ocean.
options.zh: 七百份授權真的是海洋。

options.en: There are only two licences, so choices are limitless.
options.zh: 只有兩份授權，因此選擇無限。

scene.explanationZh: 七百種方案足以支持大量選擇。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句避免把「選擇多」推成「選擇差」？

options.en: There is a sea of choices; some are excellent, but a filter would help us compare them.
options.zh: 選擇很多，其中一些很好，但篩選有助比較。

options.en: There is a sea of choices, so every item must be low quality.
options.zh: 選擇很多，因此每項必定低質。

options.en: There are three options, so they form a vast sea of choices.
options.zh: 只有三個選項，卻說選擇如海。

contrast.explanationZh: 多不等於差，數量仍應合理。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說 a sea of choices 指海邊購物。哪句較準確？

options.en: An online archive can offer a sea of choices without being near the coast.
options.zh: 網上檔案館即使不在海邊，也可提供海量選擇。

options.en: Yes, it requires seawater.
options.zh: 對，它必須有海水。

options.en: It means the list is very short.
options.zh: 它表示清單很短。

speaking.en: The library catalogue gives us a sea of choices, so I will filter by language and publication year first.
speaking.zh: 圖書館目錄提供琳瑯滿目的選擇，所以我會先按語言及出版年份篩選。
speaking.promptZh: 指出使用者採用哪兩項篩選條件。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區電影節有五百部參展短片；策展人建議觀眾先按語言與片長篩選，並說選擇多不代表每部都差。用英文說明。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩個示範都應寫出五百部短片、按語言與片長篩選，以及多不等於差。

examples.en: With five hundred short films, the festival offers a sea of choices; language and length filters can help viewers compare them without assuming the films are poor.
examples.zh: 電影節有五百部短片，選擇琳瑯滿目；按語言和片長篩選有助比較，卻不表示影片質素差。

examples.en: Viewers face a sea of choices among the festival’s five hundred shorts. Sorting by language and running time makes the list manageable, not a verdict on quality.
examples.zh: 觀眾在電影節五百部短片中面對大量選擇；按語言和片長篩選使清單較易處理，並非對質素下判斷。

takeaways.en: A sea of choices means a very large range of options.
takeaways.zh: a sea of choices 指選項極多。

takeaways.en: A sea of choices can contain good options; filters help compare them.
takeaways.zh: 大量選擇中可以有好選項；篩選有助比較。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending. Guide-written source provenance; newly written practice. No human or release approval is implied.

brief.meaningEn: Accept a claim as unquestionably true instead of checking it.
brief.meaningZh: 把某說法當成無可置疑的真理，而不加核實。
brief.grammar: Treat X like gospel / X is treated like gospel; object X is the claim, ranking or advice accepted uncritically.
brief.register: Conversational critical comment; a media-literacy teacher advises students about online rankings.
brief.boundaryZh: 質疑的是不加核實的態度，不是斷言該說法必定錯；宗教詞語在此為習語。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是要求宗教信仰；單純參考資料並再核實，不等於奉若圭臬。
brief.outcomeZh: 能分辨參考一項資訊與不加查證地全盤接受。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 270, row 6; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Online scores should not be treated like gospel.

listening.en: The app ranks parks using only photo uploads, but some users treat its list like gospel and never check access hours.
listening.zh: 程式只按照片上傳數排名公園，但有些使用者把榜單奉若圭臬，從不核對開放時間。
listening.promptZh: treat its list like gospel 表示甚麼？

options.en: Users accept the ranking without checking important facts.
options.zh: 使用者不核實重要事實便接受排名。

options.en: The list is a religious text.
options.zh: 榜單是宗教經文。

options.en: Every park ranking is proven false.
options.zh: 每份公園排名都已證明錯誤。

options.en: Users compare the list with opening hours carefully.
options.zh: 使用者仔細把榜單與開放時間比較。

listening.explanationZh: 把榜單當成無需質疑，忽略核查。

reply.promptEn: A video claims one study method works for every learner. A student follows it exactly without looking at the evidence or her own results. How is she using the claim?
reply.promptZh: （影片聲稱一種學習方法適合每位學習者；學生不看證據或自己的成效便完全照做。她怎樣看待這個說法？）

options.en: She accepts it without testing the broad claim.
options.zh: 她不測試籠統說法便接受。

options.en: She gives the video unquestioned authority.
options.zh: 她賦予影片無可質疑的權威。

options.en: She treats the advice like gospel.
options.zh: 她把建議奉若圭臬。

options.en: She does not compare it with her own results.
options.zh: 她沒有與自己的成效比較。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均指出未核證便全盤接受。

scene.promptZh: 某旅遊榜單只收集一百名受訪者意見，經理卻從不核查便照單決定所有行程。哪句貼切？

options.en: The manager treats the small survey like gospel.
options.zh: 經理把小型調查奉若圭臬。

options.en: The manager uses the survey as one source and verifies it.
options.zh: 經理只把調查作其中一個來源並加以核實。

options.en: The survey is necessarily false because it is small.
options.zh: 調查樣本小，所以必定錯誤。

scene.explanationZh: 問題在於不加查證而全盤依從。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句沒有把「需要核實」誤說成「一定錯誤」？

options.en: We should not treat the online score like gospel; let us check the inspection report too.
options.zh: 不應把網上評分奉若圭臬；也應查看檢查報告。

options.en: The score is online, so it must be wrong in every detail.
options.zh: 評分在網上，所以每個細節必定錯。

options.en: We checked three independent reports, so even cautious comparison means treating one like gospel.
options.zh: 我們比較三份獨立報告，因此謹慎比較也等於奉若圭臬。

contrast.explanationZh: 提醒查證，不預設評分必錯。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說「參考」一個排名就等於 treat it like gospel。哪句修正較準確？

options.en: You treat a ranking like gospel only when you accept it without proper checking.
options.zh: 只有不作適當查證便接受排名，才是把它奉若圭臬。

options.en: Yes, any use of a ranking is unquestioning belief.
options.zh: 對，任何使用排名都等於盲信。

options.en: The phrase means the ranking has been disproved.
options.zh: 片語表示排名已被推翻。

speaking.en: Do not treat the restaurant score like gospel; its sample is small, so read recent inspection details as well.
speaking.zh: 別把餐廳評分奉若圭臬；樣本很小，也應閱讀近期檢查資料。
speaking.promptZh: 指出應再查閱甚麼資料。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：家長看到網上學校排名，榜單只按考試分數排序，沒有涵蓋無障礙設施；她會參考榜單，也會查看學校實地資料。用英文說明不應盲信。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩個示範都應寫出榜單只按考試分數、欠缺無障礙資料、家長會參考但另外查證。

examples.en: The parent will not treat the school ranking like gospel: it uses exam scores alone and omits accessibility, so she will also inspect the school’s facilities.
examples.zh: 家長不會把學校排名奉若圭臬：榜單只用考試分數，又欠無障礙資料，因此她會另查校內設施。

examples.en: She can consult the online ranking without treating it like gospel. Because it ignores access facilities and sorts only by exam marks, she will check the school in person.
examples.zh: 她可以參考網上排名而不奉若圭臬；榜單只按考試分數排序，忽略無障礙設施，因此她會親身了解學校。

takeaways.en: Treat X like gospel means accept it without questioning.
takeaways.zh: treat X like gospel 指不加質疑地接受。

takeaways.en: Not treating a source like gospel does not mean assuming it is false.
takeaways.zh: 不奉若圭臬，不等於認定資料必錯。

notes: AI-authored provisional draft; independent English, Chinese, media and QA review remain pending. Guide-written source provenance; newly written practice. No human or release approval is implied.

brief.meaningEn: A misunderstanding caused by people receiving or interpreting different information.
brief.meaningZh: 因雙方接收或理解的資訊不一致而產生誤會。
brief.grammar: There were crossed wires over X / we got our wires crossed over X. Crossed wires is a plural noun phrase in this lesson.
brief.register: Conversational workplace clarification; an organiser explains conflicting arrival times to volunteers.
brief.boundaryZh: 重點是溝通不一致，不是電線真的交叉，也不必表示任何人蓄意誤導。
brief.misconceptionZh: 只因計劃更改而人人都收到同一新版資訊，未必有 crossed wires。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出雙方收到甚麼不同訊息及如何澄清。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 271, row 5; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: A direct call can prevent crossed wires over arrival times.

listening.en: The speaker was told noon, but the driver was told one o’clock. A quick call cleared up the crossed wires.
listening.zh: 講者獲告知中午到，司機卻被告知一時；一通電話澄清了溝通誤會。
listening.promptZh: crossed wires 在這裏表示甚麼？

options.en: Two people had conflicting arrival information.
options.zh: 兩人收到互相矛盾的到達時間。

options.en: Two electric cables touched.
options.zh: 兩條電線碰在一起。

options.en: Both were given the same time.
options.zh: 兩人獲告知相同時間。

options.en: The speaker deliberately deceived the driver.
options.zh: 講者故意欺騙司機。

listening.explanationZh: 中午與一時的資訊不一致。

reply.promptEn: The rehearsal email says 4 p.m., but the venue’s calendar says 5 p.m. Both teams are acting on their own record. What should the organiser address?
reply.promptZh: （排練電郵寫下午四時，場地日曆寫五時；兩隊人各按自己的紀錄安排。主辦者應處理甚麼？）

options.en: The teams have different schedule information.
options.zh: 兩隊有不同時間資料。

options.en: They need one confirmed rehearsal time.
options.zh: 他們需要一個核實的排練時間。

options.en: There are crossed wires over the start time.
options.zh: 開始時間出現溝通誤會。

options.en: A direct clarification would prevent further confusion.
options.zh: 直接澄清可防止進一步混亂。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均指向四時與五時資訊衝突。

scene.promptZh: 餐飲組收到「週六送貨」，場地組卻收到「週日送貨」，兩方因此作出不同準備。哪句貼切？

options.en: There are crossed wires over the delivery day.
options.zh: 送貨日期出現溝通誤會。

options.en: The electric wires in the kitchen are crossed.
options.zh: 廚房電線真的交叉。

options.en: Both teams received the same message.
options.zh: 兩隊收到相同訊息。

scene.explanationZh: 不同送貨日資料造成誤會。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句不把正常改期誤認為溝通誤會？

options.en: Both teams received the same revised time and adjusted, so there were no crossed wires.
options.zh: 兩隊都收到相同新時間並調整，因此沒有溝通誤會。

options.en: Both teams received the same update, so they definitely got their wires crossed.
options.zh: 兩隊都收到相同更新，因此必定誤會。

options.en: One team was told Monday and the other Tuesday, so there cannot be crossed wires.
options.zh: 一隊獲告知週一，另一隊週二，因此不可能有誤會。

contrast.explanationZh: 資料一致時即使改期，也不一定有誤會。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說 crossed wires 必定有人故意撒謊。哪句較準確？

options.en: Crossed wires can arise when two teams honestly receive different versions.
options.zh: 兩隊誠實地收到不同版本，也可能產生溝通誤會。

options.en: Yes, it always proves deliberate deceit.
options.zh: 對，它必定證明有人故意欺騙。

options.en: It only refers to faulty electrical wiring.
options.zh: 它只指電線故障。

dialogue.explanationZh: 不一致可由普通溝通失誤造成。

speaking.en: The guide and coach driver got their wires crossed over the pickup time, so they called to confirm the correct hour.
speaking.zh: 導遊和旅遊巴司機對接載時間有誤會，因此致電確認正確時間。
speaking.promptZh: 指出他們用甚麼方式澄清。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區合唱團電郵寫週四排練，場地日曆卻寫週五；兩方各以為自己正確，領隊打電話核實後更新同一份時間表。用英文解釋誤會及解決方式。
writing.selfCheckZh: 兩個示範都應寫出電郵週四、日曆週五、致電核實及更新共同時間表；勿指控蓄意說謊。

examples.en: There were crossed wires over rehearsal day: the choir email said Thursday, the venue calendar said Friday, and the leader called to confirm before updating the shared timetable.
examples.zh: 排練日出現溝通誤會：合唱團電郵寫週四，場地日曆寫週五，領隊致電核實後更新共同時間表。

examples.en: The choir and venue got their wires crossed when one record named Thursday and the other Friday. A call settled the day, and both now use the same schedule.
examples.zh: 合唱團和場地一方紀錄寫週四、另一方寫週五，因此有溝通誤會；一通電話定下日期，兩方現在使用同一時間表。

takeaways.en: Crossed wires means a communication mix-up.
People can have crossed wires without anyone lying.
takeaways.zh: 出現溝通誤會，不代表有人說謊。
